entities.summary:
Nivala is a town and municipality of Finland. It is located in the Northern Ostrobothnia region. The town has a population of 10,310
(31 December 2025) and covers an area of 536.88 square kilometres (207.29 sq mi) of
which 8.92 km2 (3.44 sq mi)
is water. The population density is
19.55 inhabitants per square kilometre (50.6/sq mi). The municipality is unilingually Finnish.
